# files_automation_version (Data Source)

An AutomationVersion is an immutable revision of an Automation v2 graph. Each saved graph change creates a revision. Restoring a revision saves its definition as a new current revision and keeps existing runs and Run Automation nodes pinned to their selected revisions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "files_automation_version" "example_automation_version" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Automation revision ID.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_id` (Number) ID of the API key used to save the revision, when available.
- `automation_id` (Number) ID of the Automation that owns this revision.
- `created_at` (String) Time the revision was saved.
- `definition` (Attributes) Saved Automation v2 graph definition. Included when retrieving a single revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user who saved the revision, when available.
- `username` (String) Username recorded when the revision was saved, when available.
- `version` (Number) Revision number within the Automation.
- `workspace_id` (Number) Workspace that owns the Automation. Zero is the Default Workspace.

<a id="nestedatt--definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition`

Read-Only:

- `edges` (Attributes List) Directed connections between nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--edges))
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Flat list of nodes. Every node requires a unique id and a type, accepts the node-specific config fields documented below, and action or control-flow nodes may set return to true to include their output in the Automation result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--nodes))
- `schema_version` (Number) Automation definition schema version.
